info.name: GoGovernment - Route Matched API Collection
info.description: 100% matched to backend routes (12 route files). Only actual APIs used in GoGovernment 4-app ecosystem.

request.description:
• Route: `POST /api/auth/send-otp`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.sendOtp()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Screen: `lib/screen/auth/login_screen.dart`

• Route: `POST /api/auth/verify-otp`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.verifyOtp()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Screen: `lib/screen/auth/otp_screen.dart`

• Route: `GET /api/auth/profile/:userId`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.getUserProfile()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Screen: `lib/screen/profile/profile_screen.dart`

• Route: `PUT /api/auth/update-profile`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.updateProfile()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Screen: `lib/screen/profile/edit_profile_screen.dart`

• Route: `POST /api/auth/send-phone-update-otp`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.sendPhoneUpdateOtp()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Screen: `lib/screen/profile/edit_phone_screen.dart`

• Route: `POST /api/auth/verify-phone-update-otp`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.verifyPhoneUpdateOtp()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Screen: `lib/screen/profile/edit_phone_screen.dart`

• Route: `POST /api/auth/update-fcm-token`
• Flutter: `AuthApiService.updateFcmToken()` in `lib/network/auth_api_service.dart`
• Service: `lib/service/firebase_service.dart`

• Route: `POST /api/auth/logout`
• Flutter: `AuthBloc` on `LogoutEvent`
• Screen: `lib/screen/profile/profile_screen.dart`

• Route: `GET /api/addresses/:userId`
• Flutter: `AddressApiService.getAddresses()`
• Screen: `lib/screen/profile/address_book_screen.dart`
